source_binding.source: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center, Circuit Breaker pattern
source_binding.semantics_used: CLOSED counts recent failures and opens at a threshold; OPEN rejects protected operations; after a reset interval the breaker becomes HALF_OPEN and allows a limited number of trial requests; success closes/reset counters and failure reopens.
A self-resetting breaker retries a protected call after a suitable interval; HALF_OPEN is a real trial call whose success resets the breaker and whose failure restarts the timeout.

chat_native_reduction.adaptation_note: The public pattern uses elapsed time for the reset interval. This fixed scheduled-Chat trace preserves the CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN semantics but represents the reset interval as two monotonic durable controller transitions, avoiding dependence on an external timer service. This is a reduction, not a claim of literal equivalence to time-based breaker implementations.
rules: Count only unique same-scope terminal failure identities that have independent readback.
Do not count transport/CAS/search interruption or unevaluated work as semantic failure.
At the precommitted threshold of three qualifying consecutive failures, append OPEN state for that assignment family.
While OPEN, make only that family temporarily ineligible; unrelated frontier work proceeds.
After exactly two durable unrelated controller transitions, append HALF_OPEN and permit exactly one bounded same-scope probe.
HALF_OPEN terminal success closes and resets the breaker-local consecutive-failure counter; terminal failure reopens.
Deduplicate terminal/probe identities so stale or duplicate replay cannot change breaker state twice.
Breaker state is append-only qualification over immutable evidence; CAS/readback failure leaves the prior durable breaker state authoritative.

scope: constructed role-local repeated-failure switching trace only; this tests controller breaker semantics, not service reliability or optimality of threshold=3/reset=2 transitions.
exact_next_action: Read this terminal artifact back. Only after exact readback, advance controller credit by one and select another distinct switching/recovery failure mode; precommit it before reading public semantics.
